output: prod-config: parses; development sign-in pinned off; every service Production; backup key required.
steps.note: Every check is silent (@), so a pass prints only this line. Throwaway values stand in for the seven required variables. The check then tries to turn the development sign-in on, asks for Development, and leaves the backup key empty.

variations.title: The production control plane could enable the development sign-in

output: prod-config: the production control plane could enable the development sign-in
steps.note: Printed when docker-compose.prod.yml no longer pins ENDGAME_DEV_LOGIN to the literal "false" whatever the environment says.

variations.title: A production service does not run as Production

output: prod-config: a production service does not run as Production
steps.note: Printed when any service's ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT follows ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development from the environment.

variations.title: The stack would start without the backup key

output: prod-config: the production stack does not refuse a missing ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY
steps.note: Printed when parsing with ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY empty does not fail with "ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY is required". The ops service is the stack's only backup.
